description: CLP Public Wifi is a dataset listed in Western Pennsylvania Regional Data Center (WPRDC), an open data portal, published or maintained by Carnegie Library of Pittsburgh. Carnegie Library of Pittsburgh public wifi usage by library location. Coverage: Allegheny County, Pennsylvania. The portal files it under the publisher Carnegie Library of Pittsburgh. Its tags are internet, libraries, library, wifi. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2023-05-21 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License (PDDL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-wprdc-portal.
